portal_description:
The pytz library enables platform time zone calculations using the Python 2.3 or higher. It also solves the issue of ambiguous times at the end of daylight savings. The pytz library supports over 540 Olson time zones.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.4 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of pytz are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.

abstract:
The pytz library enables platform time zone calculations using the Python 2.3 or higher. It also solves the issue of ambiguous times at the end of daylight savings. The pytz library supports over 540 Olson time zones.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.4 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of pytz are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
